extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF figure captions, methods, and parsed source-data surfaces; model-only claims are not promoted beyond supporting context.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TMcin-G1905 targets the MRSA cell membrane, releases ATP, causes membrane depolarization, and produces microscopy phenotypes consistent with loss of turgor pressure.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: TMcin-G1905 treated S. aureus USA300 LAC/MRSA cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct cellular assays support membrane damage/solute release but do not by themselves define atomic pore stoichiometry.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TMcin-G1905 directly permeabilizes phospholipid liposomes and produces large, stepwise, nonselective conductance events in planar lipid bilayers.
mechanism_claims.limitations: AF2/MD 21-mer model is retained as structural support, not as standalone direct experimental stoichiometry proof.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TMcin-G1905 permeabilizes MRSA cells to 40 kDa FITC-dextran and FITC-polysucrose, supporting large aqueous pore formation in cells.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: S. aureus USA300 LAC cells treated with TMcin-G1905
mechanism_claims.limitations: Source figure is qualitative/histogram evidence; no exact uptake percentage table was present in the local source-data XLSX.
